\section[(dialogue)]{Places, can and want — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TE-R109-first-pass-places-can-and-want}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a blanket and a curtain.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item right, left, straight ahead, near, far; distance
  \item above, below, inside, outside, behind
  \item in the middle, a street, a road, a bridge, a park
  \item a temple, a school, a library, a bank, a market
  \item a shore, an office, a garden, a corner, a turn
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Right? (\textbf{\te{కుడి}}, \emph{kuḍi}.) Left? (\textbf{\te{ఎడమ}}, \emph{eḍama}.) Straight ahead? (\textbf{\te{తిన్నగా}}, \emph{tinnagā}.) Near? (\textbf{\te{దగ్గర}}, \emph{daggara}.) Far; distance? (\textbf{\te{దూరం}}, \emph{dūraṁ}.) Above? (\textbf{\te{పైన}}, \emph{paina}.) Below? (\textbf{\te{కింద}}, \emph{kinda}.) Inside? (\textbf{\te{లోపల}}, \emph{lōpala}.) Outside? (\textbf{\te{బయట}}, \emph{bayaṭa}.) Behind? (\textbf{\te{వెనక}}, \emph{venaka}.) In the middle? (\textbf{\te{మధ్యలో}}, \emph{madhyalō}.) A street? (\textbf{\te{వీధి}}, \emph{vīdhi}.) A road? (\textbf{\te{రోడ్డు}}, \emph{rōḍḍu}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\te{వంతెన}}, \emph{vantena}.) A park? (\textbf{\te{పార్కు}}, \emph{pārku}.) A temple? (\textbf{\te{గుడి}}, \emph{guḍi}.) A school? (\textbf{\te{బడి}}, \emph{baḍi}.) A library? (\textbf{\te{గ్రంథాలయం}}, \emph{grandhālayaṁ}.) A bank? (\textbf{\te{బ్యాంకు}}, \emph{byāṅku}.) A market? (\textbf{\te{సంత}}, \emph{santa}.) A shore? (\textbf{\te{తీరం}}, \emph{tīraṁ}.) An office? (\textbf{\te{కార్యాలయం}}, \emph{kāryālayaṁ}.) A garden? (\textbf{\te{తోట}}, \emph{tōṭa}.) A corner? (\textbf{\te{మూల}}, \emph{mūla}.) A turn? (\textbf{\te{మలుపు}}, \emph{malupu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Want, why and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TE-R109-second-pass-want-why-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a station and a bus.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a station, a bus, ability, a skill, a right
  \item a chance, a tool, property, an owner, strength
  \item a wish, hope, a dream, an intention, a plan
  \item to wish for, to decide, a reason, therefore, because of
  \item that is exactly why, a bed, a pillow, a blanket, a curtain
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A station? (\textbf{\te{స్టేషన్}}, \emph{sṭēṣan}.) A bus? (\textbf{\te{బస్సు}}, \emph{bassu}.) Ability? (\textbf{\te{సామర్థ్యం}}, \emph{sāmarthyaṁ}.) A skill? (\textbf{\te{నైపుణ్యం}}, \emph{naipuṇyaṁ}.) A right? (\textbf{\te{హక్కు}}, \emph{hakku}.) A chance? (\textbf{\te{అవకాశం}}, \emph{avakāśaṁ}.) A tool? (\textbf{\te{పరికరం}}, \emph{parikaraṁ}.) Property? (\textbf{\te{ఆస్తి}}, \emph{āsti}.) An owner? (\textbf{\te{యజమాని}}, \emph{yajamāni}.) Strength? (\textbf{\te{బలం}}, \emph{balaṁ}.) A wish? (\textbf{\te{కోరిక}}, \emph{kōrika}.) Hope? (\textbf{\te{ఆశ}}, \emph{āśa}.) A dream? (\textbf{\te{కల}}, \emph{kala}.) An intention? (\textbf{\te{ఉద్దేశం}}, \emph{uddēśaṁ}.) A plan? (\textbf{\te{ప్రణాళిక}}, \emph{praṇālika}.) To wish for? (\textbf{\te{కోరు}}, \emph{kōru}.) To decide? (\textbf{\te{నిర్ణయించు}}, \emph{nirṇayiñcu}.) A reason? (\textbf{\te{కారణం}}, \emph{kāraṇaṁ}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\te{అందువల్ల}}, \emph{anduvalla}.) Because of? (\textbf{\te{వల్ల}}, \emph{valla}.) That is exactly why? (\textbf{\te{అందుకే}}, \emph{andukē}.) A bed? (\textbf{\te{మంచం}}, \emph{mañcaṁ}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\te{దిండు}}, \emph{diṇḍu}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\te{దుప్పటి}}, \emph{duppaṭi}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\te{తెర}}, \emph{tera}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
